question.text: Per Regulation 23 of SEBI (AIF) Regulations, for securities NOT covered by SEBI (MF) Regulations valuation norms, valuation must be done per guidelines endorsed by an AIF industry association. What is the minimum membership threshold for such an association?

answer.text: At least 25% of the total AUM of AIFs in India
At least 10% of SEBI-registered AIFs and approved by AIPAC
At least 50% of the number of SEBI-registered AIFs
At least 33% of the number of SEBI-registered AIFs

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 14.13, such industry association must represent AT LEAST 33% of the NUMBER of SEBI-registered AIFs. The association endorses guidelines after taking into account recommendations of the Alternative Investment Policy Advisory Committee (AIPAC) of SEBI. This is the basis under which APMI endorses IPEV guidelines. **The Trap:** 50% is too strict; 25% AUM confuses number-vs-value; 10% is too loose. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A/B test APMI's role from the distributor angle. XIX-C probes the representation threshold that gives APMI standing to endorse IPEV. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Track APMI valuation guidance updates — they are effectively binding on managers. Subscribe to their circular mailing list; most litigation over NAV disputes now references APMI-endorsed IPEV interpretation.
